item.title: American who fled Iran says citizens 'desperate' for freedom, praying for Islamic regime to fall
item.summary: Iranian-American says citizens celebrate U.S. strikes on Iran, dancing near bomb sites and reportedly thanking America for targeting the regime's military sites.

item.title: Support for Israel drops as Democrats turn against key US ally: poll
item.summary: New poll reveals dramatic shift in American views of Israel, with just 32% holding positive opinions compared to 47% three years ago amid ongoing conflict.

item.title: New terror group with reported Iran ties claims 4 attacks across Europe
item.summary: Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamiyya attacks on European Jewish institutions may be linked to Iranian proxy networks, according to security analysts and Israeli officials.

item.title: Trump scolds reporter as 'very obnoxious' over question on Air Force One, blasts 'most corrupt' ABC News
item.summary: Trump scolded "a very obnoxious" reporter who attempted to ask about sending troops to the Middle East as part of the war with Iran and blasted ABC News as "corrupt" on Sunday.

item.title: Trump admin official says there’s a 'very good chance' gas prices will be back to normal by summer
item.summary: Department of Energy Secretary Chris Wright said Iran conflict will cause short-term gas price increases, but predicts normal prices by summer as Operation Epic Fury continues.

item.title: Trump 'thrilled' as FCC chair warns news organizations to correct course or lose licenses
item.summary: Trump expresses support as FCC Chairman Brendan Carr calls for investigation into news organizations' broadcast licenses over alleged fake news coverage.

item.title: Jimmy Kimmel's Trump, Melania digs at Oscars 'fell flat' with critics
item.summary: Jimmy Kimmel faced backlash over his Oscars jokes targeting President Donald Trump and first lady Melania Trump, with a White House official calling the comedian a "classless hack."

item.title: WH chief of staff Susie Wiles diagnosed with early stage breast cancer, prognosis 'excellent,' Trump says
item.summary: President Donald Trump issued a Truth Social post on Monday announcing that his White House chief of staff Susie Wiles had received an early stage breast cancer diagnosis.

item.title: Violent DC teen takeover in upscale neighborhood escalates to gunfire
item.summary: Chaos erupted in Washington DC's Navy Yard as hundreds of teens reportedly flooded the upscale area, sparking fights, robberies and gunfire Saturday night.

item.title: Steak 'n Shake's beef tallow tater tots spark fiery online debate, both pro and con
item.summary: Bringing back 1950s-style cooking, Steak 'n Shake launches beef tallow tater tots. The chain continues its traditional frying push after switching its fries last year.
